_about: Role profiles curated by the team. Required skill levels use the 0-3 scale in skills.json; 'weight' is how important the skill is to the role (1-3). 'wef' is the baseline outlook from the WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025 (0 = not ranked by WEF, neutral prior). Roles with type 'current' are today's roles used to estimate displacement risk; they are never recommended as future roles.

roles.title: AI / Machine Learning Specialist
roles.summary: Builds, evaluates and maintains machine-learning models that power products and services.

wef.note: WEF FoJ 2025: AI and machine-learning specialists are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdgs.why: Creates the AI capability that local industry needs to innovate.
High-productivity, high-wage digital work.

roles.title: Generative AI Application Developer
roles.summary: Builds assistants, RAG search and AI-agent workflows on top of large language models, with guardrails.

wef.note: WEF FoJ 2025: AI and machine-learning specialists and software developers are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdgs.why: Turns AI research into useful local products and services.
Many GenAI apps are tutoring, translation and knowledge tools.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.summary: Turns raw data into dashboards, insights and recommendations that guide decisions.

wef.note: WEF FoJ 2025: data analysts and scientists are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdgs.why: Data capacity for monitoring progress on every goal (target 17.18).
Evidence-based decisions in industry.

roles.title: Big Data Engineer
roles.summary: Designs the pipelines and warehouses that collect, clean and serve data at scale.

wef.note: WEF FoJ 2025: big data specialists are the fastest-growing job.

sdgs.why: Builds national and corporate data infrastructure.

roles.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
roles.summary: Monitors, detects and responds to security threats, including AI-enabled attacks.

wef.note: WEF FoJ 2025: security management specialists and information security analysts are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdgs.why: Protects institutions and citizens from cybercrime.
Keeps digital infrastructure resilient.

roles.title: FinTech & Digital Banking Analyst
roles.summary: Designs and improves digital financial products such as e-wallets, digital lending and payments.

wef.note: WEF FoJ 2025: FinTech engineers are among the fastest-growing jobs (closest WEF category).

sdgs.why: Financial inclusion for unbanked and underbanked communities.
Access to finance for SMEs and micro-entrepreneurs (target 8.10).

roles.title: UX/UI Designer for AI Products
roles.summary: Designs human-centred, accessible interfaces where people and AI work together.

wef.note: WEF FoJ 2025: UI and UX designers are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdgs.why: Accessible design includes older users and people with disabilities.
Better digital products and public services.

roles.title: Responsible AI & Governance Officer
roles.summary: Checks AI systems for bias, privacy and safety risks and helps organisations govern AI use.

wef.note: Emerging role not ranked in WEF FoJ 2025; neutral prior, outlook driven by live signals.

sdgs.why: Accountable, transparent institutions in the AI era.
Prevents AI from discriminating by age, gender or background.
Audits for gender bias in automated decisions.

roles.title: AI Trainer & Digital Skills Educator
roles.summary: Teaches workers, students and communities to use AI tools safely and productively.

wef.note: Not ranked in WEF FoJ 2025; neutral prior.

sdgs.why: Directly delivers relevant skills for employment (target 4.4).
Brings AI skills to groups left behind.
Can target women re-entering the workforce.

roles.title: Solar & Renewable Energy Technician
roles.summary: Installs, monitors and maintains solar PV and storage systems, increasingly with smart monitoring.

wef.note: WEF FoJ 2025: renewable energy engineers are among the fastest-growing jobs (closest WEF category).

sdgs.why: Expands access to affordable, clean energy.
Cuts power-sector emissions.

roles.title: EV & Smart Mobility Technician
roles.summary: Services electric vehicles, batteries and charging infrastructure.

wef.note: WEF FoJ 2025: autonomous and electric vehicle specialists are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdgs.why: Cleaner urban transport.
Lower transport emissions.
Electrified mobility paired with clean power.

roles.title: Sustainability & ESG Analyst
roles.summary: Measures, reports and helps reduce a company's environmental and social impact.

wef.note: Not ranked as a job in WEF FoJ 2025 (environmental stewardship is a top-10 rising skill); neutral prior.

sdgs.why: Sustainability reporting by companies (target 12.6).
Carbon accounting drives emission cuts.
Links companies to national SDG commitments.

roles.title: Smart Agriculture Technologist
roles.summary: Uses sensors, drones and data to help farms and plantations produce more with less.

wef.note: Not ranked as a job in WEF FoJ 2025; neutral prior.

sdgs.why: Raises yields and smallholder incomes.
Less water and fertiliser per tonne of food.
Reduces pressure on forests and land.

roles.title: Digital Health Informatics Specialist
roles.summary: Manages health data systems, telehealth platforms and safe use of AI in clinics.

wef.note: Not ranked in WEF FoJ 2025; neutral prior.

sdgs.why: Better, more accessible health services (target 3.8).
Digital public health infrastructure.

roles.title: AI-assisted Care Coordinator
roles.summary: Coordinates patient and elderly care, using digital tools for scheduling, monitoring and records.

wef.note: Not ranked in WEF FoJ 2025 fastest-growing list; neutral prior.

sdgs.why: Care for an ageing population.
Recognises and professionalises care work (target 5.4).
Keeps human care accessible as services digitise.

roles.title: IoT Solutions Specialist
roles.summary: Connects sensors and machines to the cloud for smart factories, buildings and cities.

wef.note: WEF FoJ 2025: Internet of Things specialists are among the fastest-growing jobs.

sdgs.why: Smart city services and utilities.
Industry 4.0 for Malaysian manufacturing.

roles.title: Climate & Environmental Data Scientist
roles.summary: Models climate risk, emissions, floods and land use to guide policy and investment.

wef.note: Not ranked in WEF FoJ 2025; neutral prior.

sdgs.why: Climate risk analysis for adaptation and mitigation.
Ocean and coastal monitoring.
Forest and land-use monitoring.

roles.title: AI-augmented Digital Marketing Strategist
roles.summary: Plans campaigns and content with AI tools, focusing on strategy, brand and measurement.

wef.note: Not ranked in WEF FoJ 2025; neutral prior.

sdgs.why: Helps local SMEs reach new markets.

roles.title: AI-augmented Customer Experience Specialist
roles.summary: Handles complex customer cases that AI chatbots escalate, and improves the AI's answers.

wef.note: Not ranked in WEF FoJ 2025; neutral prior.

sdgs.why: Keeps service work decent and higher-skilled as AI automates simple queries.
Human help for customers who struggle with digital channels.

roles.title: Digital Transformation Project Manager
roles.summary: Leads teams through adopting AI and new digital processes, including reskilling.

wef.note: Not ranked in WEF FoJ 2025 (leadership and social influence is a top-10 rising skill); neutral prior.

sdgs.why: Modernises organisations and infrastructure.
Manages change so workers are reskilled, not dropped.
Coordinates partners across the organisation.
